title: Gold-based multimetallic catalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00282F, Review Article
Arup Jyoti Das, Shivhar B. Ambegave, Aliya V. Jinilkumar, Kumarjit Sen, Nitin T. Patil
This review provides an up-to-date overview of developments in gold-based multimetallic catalysis, with particular emphasis on mechanistic aspects and highlights its potential for enabling new organic transformations.
